specific_diseases_listed: Fistula in anus / Anal Sinus / Piles (12 months)
Uterine Fibroids / PV Bleeding / Hysterectomy / Myomectomy (24 months)
Gall Bladder / Biliary / Renal / Urinary Stones (24 months)
Benign growth / Cyst / Nodules / Polyps / Tumor (24 months)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months. Specific disease 12 or 24 months by condition. 30-day initial waiting (except accident).

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room Rent 2% SI/day or single AC private room; ICU 3% SI/day. Variant plans cap rooms (1.5%/1.25% for Class A cities).
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Proportionate deduction if room category higher than entitled; clause floors at 40% of claim if hospital tariff unavailable

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to SI per IRDAI definition

maternity_coverage.notes: Not a base benefit; check specific variant for optional rider

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance covered subject to limit

critical_illness_cover.notes: Available as optional add-on or separate IFFCO-Tokio CI Benefit Policy

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Preventive health check-up benefit subject to plan variant

room_rent_capping: 2% of SI per day or single private AC room (default); variant plans cap to 1.5%/1.25% per day in metro/non-metro cities
icu_capping: 3% of SI per day (default); variant plans cap to 2.5%/2% per day
copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary co-pay options 10%, 20% or 25% available for premium discount. Once opted cannot be removed mid-policy.

disease_wise_sub_limits.service_charges_and_surcharge: Subject to maximum 0.5% of SI per item

notable_exclusions_summary: Indemnity plan with 36-month PED, 30-day initial wait, and tiered 12/24-month specific disease waits. Room rent capped 2% SI/day, ICU 3% SI/day by default with stricter variant caps. Voluntary 10%/20%/25% co-pay available for premium discount. Maternity, infertility, cosmetic surgery, and other standard IRDAI exclusions apply.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via IFFCO-Tokio empanelled network; pre-authorisation via TPA; proportionate clause for hospitalisation in room above entitlement.
